title: kith-tui: CRLF normalize on every chunk is O(n) scan of full buffer
description: run_sse in client.rs calls buf.replace(CRLF).replace(CR) on every received chunk. This is correct (solves the split-CRLF bug). The replace chain allocates a new String on every chunk, then discards the original buf. For a long-running SSE stream with frequent small chunks this is an O(n) allocation on each chunk where n=buf.len(). A more efficient approach: defer normalization to the frame extraction loop — scan char-by-char and normalize when building lines. Alternative: use a BytesMut ring buffer that handles CRLF at read time. At current scale (SSE is low-frequency, chunks are small) this is not a performance concern; filing as elegance not efficiency.
